missing_statement_fields: rate or intensity parameter and admissible boundary cases
lean_elaboration_ineligibility: There is no source-faithful proposition to submit to Lean. Elaborating a definition, existence theorem, increment law, characterization, or limit theorem would choose a materially different target and violate the no-substitution gate.
excluded_substitutions: definition of a homogeneous Poisson process
existence or uniqueness in law at a chosen rate
retry_condition: The authoritative source scope must be amended with an exact proposition or an unambiguous theorem-bearing citation that fixes every binder, hypothesis, conclusion, and degenerate case. Only then may the statement phase select minimal imports and run lake env lean.
